narrationTexts: Straightforward priority-to-channel mapping. Let me implement it.

finalText: These match the flap events (fired 2 minutes after the original with the same key), correctly deduped and dropped regardless of priority. 99 dropped, 0 errors — dedup is working correctly across all priority tiers, including critical.
